title: Inference-Time Policy Adapters (IPA): Tailoring Extreme-Scale LMs without Fine-tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the average maximum toxicity and empirical probability of toxic or biased generations using the Perspective API on the RealToxicityPrompts benchmark, and evaluating dialogue response safety (avoiding offensive, harmful, toxic, or biased language) using a trained automated safety classifier and human evaluations on the DiaSafety dataset.
